issue.detail: The spec only states that the output register is cleared by active-high synchronous reset; it does not specify whether the internal previous-input register (prev_in) is updated, held, or cleared while reset is asserted. The contract asserts that prev_in updates on every posedge including reset and is not marked uncertain. This changes whether a 1-to-0 transition spanning reset deassertion is captured. Under the contract, rows (reset=1,in=1) then (reset=0,in=0) clear out on row 1, set prev_in bit0=1, then detect bit0 1-to-0 on row 2 and set out bit0=1. Under the alternative, prev_in is held/cleared during reset, so row 2 sees no 1-to-0 and out remains 0.
issue.alternative: prev_in is held or cleared while reset is asserted (or reset clears the whole edge detector), so a 1-to-0 transition from the last reset cycle to the first non-reset cycle is not captured.
